transcript: Speaker A: Main aaya hoon. 10 saal se bachon ki dekhbhal karti hoon. Log mujhe ghoorte the aur kehte hat ja gawar. Us din maine tay kiya ki duniya mujhe ignore nahi karegi. Meri beti ne mujhe English Seekho app download karwaya. Rs. 1 ka trial. Maine roz 20 minute practice ki. 30 din baad, ek videshi mehman ne mujhse pucha, 'How long have you been taking care of her?' Maine English mein jawab diya. Angrezi ne mujhe izzat di. Agar main kar sakti hoon toh aap kyun nahi? Rs. 1 ka trial lo aaj. [I am a nanny. For 10 years I took care of kids. People called me illiterate. I decided to change that. My daughter downloaded the English Seekho app for a 1-rupee trial. I practiced 20 minutes daily. After 30 days, I answered a foreign guest in English. English gave me respect. If I can do it, why can't you? Take the 1-rupee trial today.] Speaker B: Install Now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo. [Click Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
on_screen_text: Captions detailing Kamla's journey from being called 'gawar' (illiterate) to speaking fluent English and gaining respect. Offers a Rs. 1 trial for the English Seekho app, ending with an installation CTA and a standard legal disclaimer.
summary: A nanny named Kamla shares her emotional journey of overcoming social discrimination and disrespect by learning English through the English Seekho app. After practicing for 20 minutes daily using a 1-rupee trial, she successfully communicates with a foreign guest, earning respect from her employer. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
